title: Quest Foglight for Databases Incorrect Permission Assignment Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-92200)
description: CVE-2026-92200 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases caused by incorrect permission assignment on a folder used by the product installer. An attacker with the ability to execute low-privileged code locally can exploit this flaw to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM-level permissions.
